issues.failure_explanation: The set X_{\delta,\theta} allows |w| up to \delta^{-\theta}, so \sqrt{\delta}w can have size \delta^{1/2-\theta}. For a fixed open set O, points x can be arbitrarily close to \partial O, hence no single \delta_1>0 can ensure x+\sqrt{\delta}w\in O for all x\in O and all \delta\le\delta_1. The proof chooses \delta_1 after x, so it supports only a localized version, not the stated uniform one.
